messages.text: Happy to. I don't have an order on this chat yet, so tell me the state or country you'd mine from, and I'll price the Harlo B30 ($899, 30 TH/s) and the Magic Miner 40T ($799, 40 TH/s) against your local power. If you know your rate per kWh, give me that too and I'll use it instead of the regional average. Got an order number? I'll pull the address off it and skip the questions.

These are at a generic $0.170/kWh, since the relay didn't have a Greece rate. Greek retail power is usually higher, so tell me your actual per kWh and I'll rerun it.

Harlo B30, $899, 30 TH/s at 405 W: about 42,800 sats a month, worth roughly $36 today. Power runs about $50 a month. Break-even BTC price $117,241. Solo block odds about 1 in 219,980 a day, 0.17% over a year.

Magic Miner 40T, $799, 40 TH/s at 650 W: about 57,100 sats a month, worth roughly $48. Power about $81 a month. Break-even $141,124. Odds 1 in 164,985 a day, 0.22% a year.

At that rate neither nets cash today. It's sats stacking plus the jackpot shot. The B30 is the gentler one on power and closer to break-even, the 40T buys you more hashrate per dollar and better odds.

One thing on price: both ship from the US warehouse, so 21% import VAT is not included and is charged on delivery by customs, plus any duty. We don't collect it at checkout.
